fields.description: ASCII sentinel 'COLU' (Columns) opening the save record; raw EEPROM bytes at 0x04 read 'ULOC', which is this word with each 8-byte EEPROM block byte-reversed.
fields.evidence: FUN_080004a0 record-table selector indexes the active save record; the 4-byte word at save-logical 0x00 decodes as ASCII COLU and matches the stub magic (raw ULOC at 0x04) after the 8-byte EEPROM block reversal. Verified 100% against samples/baseline.sav in the rev8-logical domain.
fields.name: header_magic

fields.description: First player/file name entry, Shift-JIS 'JADE' (8 bytes: 82 69 82 60 82 63 82 64), null-padded name slot in the header.
fields.evidence: FUN_080004a0 scans a record table (0x19 entries of 8 bytes) to select the active name/file slot; save-logical 0x0C holds Shift-JIS bytes decoding to 'JADE'. Matches baseline.sav exactly.
fields.name: player_name_1

fields.description: Second player/file name entry, Shift-JIS 'RUBY' (8 bytes: 82 71 82 74 82 61 82 78), null-padded name slot in the header.
fields.evidence: FUN_080004a0 record-table selector (alternate base table path via DAT_080004f0) covers the second name slot; save-logical 0x18 holds Shift-JIS bytes decoding to 'RUBY'. Matches baseline.sav exactly.
fields.name: player_name_2

fields.description: Primary table of 7 unlock/rival name strings (Shift-JIS: JADE, RUBY, DAZZLEPINCH, B.ZEVOJINX, ROB-55SPARKLD.W., LORTO, MILCHEDEENE), each null-padded; 142 bytes ending at 0xEE.
fields.evidence: FUN_080201d0 bulk-copies 0xC0 halfwords between the RAM record buffer and the save staging area, covering the 142-byte name table at save-logical 0x60; FUN_080209f4 performs the word-granular record copy of the same region. Byte content verified against baseline.sav (Shift-JIS decodes cleanly).
fields.name: rival_table_primary

fields.description: Redundant backup copy of the 142-byte rival name table; byte-identical to rival_table_primary in baseline.sav (offsets shifted by +0xCE).
fields.evidence: Same FUN_080201d0 0xC0-halfword bulk-copy path writes the mirror at save-logical 0x12E; FUN_080209f4 record copy covers the duplicate. Verified byte-identical to save-logical [0x60,0xEE) in baseline.sav, hence grouped in copy_groups.
fields.name: rival_table_backup

fields.description: Per-entry stage/level byte for each of the 12 score records: 06 05 05 04 04 03 03 02 02 01 01 00, trailing zero marks the empty slot.
fields.evidence: FUN_080209f4 copies per-record bytes gated by a count field into the save staging area; the 12 level bytes at save-logical 0xF0 pair 1:1 with the 12 score ranks at 0x100. Values verified against baseline.sav.
fields.name: stage_level_table

fields.description: Stored 32-bit trailer word of the primary record (0x028A0AAA); no Schema-V2 checksum algorithm over any save region reproduces it, so it is exposed as a plain word (see SPEC.md).
fields.evidence: FUN_0801f5a4 state machine guards record commit on marker byte param_1[0x0D] vs DAT_0801f5a0 and counter param_1+0x34; the stored word at save-logical 0xFC is the record trailer it protects. Value verified against baseline.sav; formula unidentified.
fields.name: record_seal_primary

fields.description: Rank-1 score, 600. Twelve u16_le scores descend monotonically 600..0 with the trailing zero marking the empty slot.
fields.evidence: FUN_080209f4 word-granular record copy moves the score table from the RAM record struct to the save staging area; save-logical 0x100 reads 600 (u16_le). Verified against baseline.sav.
fields.name: score_rank_01

fields.name: record_seal_backup

fields.description: ASCII sentinel 'COLU' closing the save record at the end of the EEPROM image; footer mirror of header_magic.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801ea30 flagged-record teardown (0x80 flag) bounds the record whose tail sentinel sits at save-logical 0x1F6; bytes decode as ASCII COLU. Verified 100% against samples/baseline.sav in the rev8-logical domain.
fields.name: footer_magic
